_doc: Per reference: source, state, and rough ring guesses [cx, cy, r, [a0, a1], mode, window] (OpenCV source px; angles clockwise from 12 in the SOURCE). bezel = the thin outer white ring (outermost ridge in the window), inner = the inner disc's rim (strongest ridge). Guesses only seed the ridge search; every published number comes from the fits. lines: boxes [x0, y0, x1, y1] in RECTIFIED dial px around a straight horizontal design line (edge = strongest vertical gradient per column); used only to check the rectification (tilt vs the centre line, straightness).
